slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: goal_label
slots.about: names what the day's goal counts

slots.name: unit
slots.about: after every amount, with a leading space if a word

slots.name: parts
slots.about: 1..3 of id (1..3), label, target; what the total splits into

slots.name: day_slots
slots.about: id (1..n), label, preset_name, preset_part, preset_amount; one diary row each

slots.name: entries
slots.about: saved: id, date, slot, part, name, amount

slots.name: of_word
slots.about: spoken between total and goal, with spaces

slots.name: left_word
slots.about: after what is left, with a leading space

slots.name: over_word
slots.about: after how far past the goal, with a leading space

slots.name: empty_slot_line
slots.about: a row with nothing logged yet

slots.name: and_word
slots.about: between the first name and the count of the others, with spaces

slots.name: more_word
slots.about: after the count of the others, with a leading space

under.shows: today's total against the goal, a bar, what is left; each part against its own target; each day slot with its first entry and a count of the rest

over.shows: the bar and the left line turn destructive and say how far past the goal

empty_slot.shows: a slot with nothing logged shows empty_slot_line and no amount

labels.hero: total of_word goal, then what is left or over
labels.log: log_word, the preset name and the slot

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and smooth
accessibility.not_colour_alone: every bar has its numbers in text beside it; over the goal is said in words
